issues.description:
Establish the technical core (Laravel 13, React 19, PostgreSQL). Goal: High-performance architecture.

**Dates**: March 15 - March 25

As a developer, I want a robust PostgreSQL/Laravel foundation.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Modular structure (Domain-Driven Design)
- PostgreSQL DB Migrations tested
- Vite/Tailwind 4 custom configuration

**Definition of Done:**
- 100% baseline API coverage
- Environment variables documented.

As a designer/dev, I want a glassmorphic UI.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- HSL color tokens defined
- Kinetic shadows implemented
- Global Typography set

**Definition of Done:**
- Global style guide implemented in CSS variables.

Advanced security layer including 2FA and Role Management.

**Dates**: March 26 - April 05

As a user, I want 2FA security to protect my data.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- System detects new login IPs
- Secure OTP hash validation
- Email notification via SMTP

**Definition of Done:**
- Rate limiting enforced on OTP endpoints.

Project management and multi-user collaboration.

**Dates**: April 06 - April 15

As an owner, I want to invite team members via email.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Secure invite tokens generated
- Role selection (Viewer, Member, Manager)
- Batch email notifications

**Definition of Done:**
- End-to-end integration tests passing.

The core kanban board and sprint management experience.

**Dates**: April 16 - April 30

As a user, I want a fluid drag-and-drop board.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Zero-lag state synchronization
- Kinetic animations on drag
- Column CRUD

**Definition of Done:**
- Responsive design verified on mobile/tablet.
